decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service builds on the firm's established offer and fits its strategy of being a single provider. Its results are still uncertain, but no shortfall against aspiration has been reported, and a large, expanding firm has the slack to keep carrying it.

The call number routing platform is close to the core voice business and has its own web page, which signals commitment. It gives no clear performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, and keeping it costs little given the firm's slack.
